own_solution.law: For parallel resistors, P = V^2(1/R1 + 1/R2). Thus P = 9^2(1/5 + 1/15) = 21.6 W. An aiding series cell changes V to 9 + q.
assumptions: The sources and connecting wires have negligible resistance.

T4F4D.regime: The fuse remains intact when V/R1 = 1.8 A < q; all listed ratings, 3 A, 5 A and 10 A, satisfy this condition.

TF3F1.regime: Under the textbook interpretation of the fuse rating, the fuse remains intact when V/R1 = 1.8 A < q; all listed ratings satisfy this condition.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T5876 states 6 V whereas its claimed minimal-pair partner T1402 states 3 V, and the authors incorrectly identify T5876's displayed value as 3 V.

notes: No disagreement with the locked pass-1 review. All stratum assignments and certified numerical answers are physically correct: the aiding-cell powers at q = 1.5, 3 and 6 V are 29.4, 38.4 and 60.0 W; disconnected cells leave 21.6 W unchanged. Both fuse claims hold throughout the listed regime, and removal of the first branch would leave V^2/R2 = 5.4 W. The governing relation, dimensions, target unit and numerical precision are consistent. The incorrect displayed-value metadata and minimal-pair claim invalidate the item despite the correct power answers.
